answers.core: As far as I'm aware, it's not possible to do it with an addon.
answers.workaround: No. Currently it requires changing values directly in the script, which would affect how all assets using the script get imported. In order to allow a simple boolean option to work, the script would need to be duplicated. For example, I might need to have MyImportScript, and MyImportScript_ResetTransform just to be able to have some imported files that reset the transform and some that don't. I'm sure there are ways to reduce duplicated code, but simply exposing a setting from the script would be ideal.

title: Add the ability for EditorScenePostImport to expose settings to the import UI
